race.comment: HIP HIP OLE (7) is the one to beat despite a last-start failure at Rosehill, with the return from Saturday company a major factor and her Wagga third two back giving the form a much cleaner look. The Rosehill run is easy enough to treat cautiously after she was bumped near the 300m and eased down late, and her record around 1500m reads strongly. DEELING ACES (11) resumes from a six-month break with a useful Wangaratta jumpout behind her and brings a sharp Corowa BM58 win from last campaign. Rates highly on her form last campaign and is still a lightly raced commodity. GOLD TRACKER (8) has the confidence of a last-start win at this venue and solid local figures, though he has to repeat that form from a wider draw. ANNOTATE (4) was only fair at Swan Hill but returns to a proven trip after winning well at Tatura, making him a genuine danger if he settles into the race cleanly. STAR BLAZER (2) is next best.
